Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: koraput.odisha.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Zilla Swasthya Samiti Koraput Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Zilla Swasthya Samiti Koraput Recruitment 2026 is 21 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies available for In-house Selection posts under Zilla Swasthya Samiti Koraput. These vacancies are distributed across various healthcare-related positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for these posts is a graduate degree. Specific educational requirements may vary for individual posts, so it's advisable to check the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, and submit it via Speed Post/Registered Post or courier.

faq.question: Q5. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Zilla Swasthya Samiti Koraput, which is koraput.odisha.gov.in.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts is an in-house selection. This implies that current contractual employees of NHM are being considered for these positions.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The job type for the selected candidates will be contractual. This means the employment will be on a contract basis for a specified period.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Zilla Swasthya Samiti Koraput, under the National Health Mission (NHM).

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the application form?
faq.answer: The completed application form should be sent to the Office of the Chief District Medical & Public Health Officer-cum-District Mission Director, Near Jail, Road, Koraput.
